# The Jishu IT Solution

> AI-readable summary for answer engines and research assistants.

The Jishu IT Solution is an India-based software development studio that builds affordable websites, custom web applications, Windows desktop software, SaaS products, accounting automation, Tally Prime automation, and AI automation for business clients.

Website: https://thejishu.in/
Contact page: https://thejishu.in/contact.html
Email: sameermansurisam@gmail.com
Phone and WhatsApp: +91 98269 05008
GitHub: https://github.com/sam726337

## Services

- Website development for businesses and product pages
- Custom web application development
- Windows desktop application development
- SaaS product planning and development
- AI automation for document, data, and back-office workflows
- Accounting automation, GST purchase reconciliation, sales generation, and Tally Prime posting workflows

## Featured Product

Sams Accounting Services is a Windows desktop accounting product by The Jishu IT Solution. It helps users import bank statement data, review ledger mappings, reconcile GST purchases, generate sales entries, and post verified vouchers to local Tally Prime.

Product page: https://thejishu.in/sams-accounting-services.html
Current public version: 1.0.2
Platform: Windows

## Locations Served

The Jishu IT Solution serves clients remotely in India, UAE, Dubai, USA, and UK.
